svg.title: PSI and AUC change across 200 synthetic trials
svg.desc: All 200 archived synthetic trials: 40 seeds in each of five scenarios. Horizontal axis: maximum feature PSI. Vertical axis: reference AUC minus current AUC. Dashed thresholds: PSI 0.20 and AUC drop 0.08. Negative AUC drop means improved AUC. Synthetic development results, not production estimates or biological validation. The positive-rate scenario is not pure label shift. Input SHA-256: bdfffa3a451fefe6cf8ec0b4a39ea8f36db4ddf75c1e7c85621d574dab037c7a; source commit: b25bbd7d0f0d589360350e6df8bf5f4391013c7f.
